source_evidence: if you are saving for a short-term goal, five years or less, you don’t want to choose risky investments, because when it’s time to sell, you may have to take a loss.
answer: Your investment time horizon is when you expect to need the money. It can help guide how much investment risk is appropriate to consider: the source contrasts a retirement goal 35 years away with a short-term goal of five years or less. For a short-term goal, a risky investment could leave you needing to sell at a loss. For a longer-term goal, the source says you may want to consider riskier investments, while also weighing your goals and comfort with the possibility of losing principal.
